text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPEN: Dedicated pool 'platinum-01' hitting GPU capacity exhaustion for tenant ParkLaneCorp (tenant-id: pl-998). Queue depth > 95% and 503s being observed on tenant routes. Auto-burst not triggered. Paging oncall.
neha: I'm on it. looking at prometheus and queue metrics now. tagging @ajay for autoscale side.
ajay: looking... saw a slow spike starting ~10m ago. autoscaler logs show rate_limit_burst=false for this tenant. investigating why burst didn't kick.
sam: parklane SRE (park_stephanie) just DMed that their ops are seeing timeouts and some inference requests failing entirely. they're asking for ETA.
neha: quick customer impact summary: ~30% of ParkLane requests getting 503s, avg tail latency 4.2s -> 12s. non-ParkLane traffic unaffected. this is tenant isolation working but customer is impacted.
ajay: pasted autoscaler snippet:
```
2026-03-14T15:02:10Z autoscaler[platinum-01]: tenant=pl-998 queue_depth=96% burst_enabled=false policy=reserved
2026-03-14T15:02:12Z autoscaler[platinum-01]: decision=NO_BURST reason="burst disabled by tenant policy"
```
neha: ok looks like this tenant has burst disabled in the account config. ParkLane requested burst in the past but had compliance flag set. we need an emergency override with approval.
park_stephanie: thanks for the quick response team. we can accept temporary burst for 2 hours while we backfill traffic. require audit logs for the change and confirmation when revert happens.
neha: @park_stephanie noted. we need SOC signoff? @eva from security can you confirm emergency temporary burst is okay with audit requirements?
eva: I can sign off provided we apply it via console with `audit=true` and generate an HMAC token for the action. I'll coordinate with infra.
ajay: proposed mitigations:
- Option A: Emergency burst override for tenant for 2 hours (fastest)
- Option B: Apply tenant-level throttling to deprioritize non-critical routes + migrate heavy models to smaller variant
- Option C: Drain some low-priority dedicated pools and provision burst nodes (slower)
neha: Option A is quickest. if security signs off, we enable burst, set quota to +30% GPUs for 2h, and start a background task to migrate large batches to smaller model variants.
infra-oncall: node provisioning queue currently has ~6 min lead time for dedicated burst nodes in this region. but override that pins existing pool to allow tenant burst using reserved slack capacity (we have ~8% spare).
ajay: executing emergency override now. command:
```
# emergency burst override for tenant pl-998
redwoodctl pool burst-override --tenant pl-998 --add-gpus 8 --duration 2h --audit true --by=ajay
```
incident-bot: action queued: `burst-override` requested by ajay. awaiting infra-oncall confirmation.
infra-oncall: confirmed. applying override. will monitor GPU queues and throughputs.
( ~2 minutes of quiet while change applies )
neha: burst applied. pool allocation shows +8 GPUs moved to platinum-01 and ParkLane queue depth dropping.
sam: customer reports errors dropping to near zero. tail latency now ~1.1s. ParkLane confirms traffic stabilizing.
park_stephanie: Confirmed. Thanks. Please keep burst for 2 hours and notify before revert.
neha: logging change and tagging security. Will schedule automated revert at 2h. follow-up actions:
- Create incident ticket INC-PL-20260314
- Postmortem owner: ajay
- Add to backlog: verify tenant burst policy UX to allow emergency approvals
liam: I'm taking second-half shift handoff. summary for @oncall-next: ParkLane (pl-998) experienced dedicated pool GPU exhaustion due to sudden spike in batch workloads. Emergency burst override (+8 GPUs) applied at 2026-03-14T15:05Z, capacity stable. Customer impact ~30% 503s for ~12 minutes prior to override. Postmortem assigned to ajay. I'm primary oncall for next 4h.
support-engineer: opening a high-priority support ticket and sending the audit logs to ParkLane as requested. ticket: SR-7944
neha: thumbs up, taking notes for incident timeline. tagging #postmortems and #dedicated-ops. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
liam: leaving handoff log in case someone needs it: `burst_override_id=bo-8934 duration=2h added_gpus=8 reverted=false`
incident-bot: Incident state: Mitigated -> monitoring. next update expected by 2026-03-14T17:05Z or on any regression.
neha: will check metrics at +15m and +60m. if anything changes, I'll escalate. closing active paging. :phone_off_hook:
